common.tagline: A quiet place to check in
common.offline: You're offline — everything still works and will sync later.

crisis.bar: Need to talk to someone now?
crisis.title: Help, whenever you need it
crisis.intro: You don't have to go through this alone. These services are free and confidential. You can call any time — you don't need to explain everything.
crisis.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call 112.

kiran.name: KIRAN Mental Health Helpline
kiran.desc: Government of India. Toll-free, 24 hours, 7 days. Support in many Indian languages.

icall.name: iCall
icall.desc: Free, confidential counselling by trained professionals. Find their phone and chat hours on the website.

nhaa.name: National Helpline Against Atrocities
nhaa.desc: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment. To report an atrocity or ask about your rights and relief.

crisis.flagged: We've flagged this for a counselor to review. Someone will reach out to you.
crisis.flaggedMore: If you want to talk to someone right now, these lines are open:

sync.crisisPending: Sending to your counselor — will keep trying
sync.label: Sync status: {{status}}

home.greeting: Hello. How are you doing today?
home.sub: Checking in takes about a minute. You can skip anything.
home.levelDaily: We'll gently remind you to check in once a day for a while. You can change this any time.
home.levelGentle: We'll remind you every few days. You can check in whenever you like.

checkin.disclosure1: Your answers are saved on this device first — even without internet.
checkin.disclosure2: Your counselor may see how you're doing, so they can reach out if things seem hard.
checkin.disclosure3: Anything you write stays on this device unless you choose to share it in Sharing settings — or it sounds like you may be in danger, then it goes to your counselor so they can help.
checkin.disclosure4: Every question is optional. Skip whatever you like.

heavy.text: Over the last few days, how heavy have things felt?

interest.text: How much have you felt like doing your usual things?

sleep.text: How have you been resting or sleeping?

safe.text: How safe have you felt where you are?

checkin.wordsTitle: Is there anything you'd like to say?
checkin.wordsSub: Only if you want to. Choose whichever is easiest.
checkin.textPlaceholder: Write as much or as little as you like…
checkin.voiceRecording: Listening… tap Stop when you're done.
checkin.voiceKept: We noted how your voice sounded. The recording itself is not kept.
checkin.voiceTranscribed: Here's what we heard — you can edit it:
checkin.voiceNoTranscript: We couldn't turn your voice into words right now. You can write instead, or just save — that's fine too.
checkin.voiceNoMic: Your microphone isn't available. You can write instead, or just save.
checkin.voiceConsentNeeded: To turn speech into words, your recording is sent to a speech service. Turn on "Voice to text" in Sharing to allow this. Otherwise we only note how your voice sounded, on this device.

entries.title: My entries
entries.intro: Everything you've checked in with. Only you see your words here. You can erase anything you wrote.
entries.empty: Nothing here yet. Your check-ins will appear here.
entries.eraseConfirm: Erase these words? This can't be undone. Your answers stay.

sharing.title: What I've agreed to share
sharing.intro: You're in charge of this. Change your mind any time — every change is recorded, and nothing is shared without your say, except when you might be in danger.

share-free-text.title: Share what I write
share-free-text.desc: Your counselor can read the words you write in check-ins. If you turn this off, they can't see them any more.

share-voice-features.title: Share how my voice sounded
share-voice-features.desc: Only simple measurements (like how steady your voice was). Never the recording.

voice-transcription.title: Voice to text
voice-transcription.desc: When you speak a check-in, send the recording to a speech service to turn it into words. The recording is not kept.

counselor-contact.title: My counselor may contact me
counselor-contact.desc: If things seem hard, your counselor may call or message you.

case-linking.title: Link my case updates
case-linking.desc: Show hearing dates and compensation updates from your case record here.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hearingNote: Court hearing date from your case record

s1.title: Check in, in your own way
s1.body: Tap, write or speak — whatever feels easiest. Every question can be skipped.

s2.title: Works without internet
s2.body: Everything is saved on this phone first. It syncs quietly when you're back online.

s3.title: Your words stay with you
s3.body: What you write stays on this device unless you choose to share it.

s4.title: Someone is looking out for you
s4.body: If things seem to be getting harder, your counselor will know to reach out.

s5.title: Help is always here
s5.body: The help line at the top of every screen is free and open 24/7.
